canonical_operation.verification: focused runtime tests prove local cancellation and server-derived reply context

source_behavior.summary: CancelReplyClicked calls CancelReply, clears the active comment reply target and reply text, and performs no persistence or WordPress mutation.
source_behavior.busy_behavior: Cancel is disabled while the source reply operation is working
source_behavior.success_semantics: no success receipt is emitted for cancellation

laravel_adaptation.runtime_wiring: The existing CommentsCommentLinksControl, already mounted only on route.key === comments, reuses the authoritative comments collection to open a reply draft for a persisted comment. The canonical Cancel button clears only the selected comment id, draft text, and local validation state.

runtime_path: the authenticated Comments workspace receives server-built FrontendContext for the active tenant and site
the existing tenant/site comments API supplies persisted comment ids under content.view
reply controls render only when FrontendContext.permissions contains content.edit or wildcard permission
a user opens a local draft for one persisted comment row
CancelReplyClicked adaptation is disabled while a supporting reply mutation is pending
Cancel clears replyingTo, draft text, and local validation state without issuing an HTTP mutation

authorization.session: tenant.context rejects unauthenticated API access with 401 and activates only an active membership for the route tenant slug
authorization.cancel: reachable only from the content.edit-gated reply editor

tenant_isolation.supporting_reply_target: same-origin child path of the authoritative comments collection only
tenant_isolation.backend_idor_guard: Comment query requires site_id == route site before findOrFail
tenant_isolation.foreign_tenant_guard: ResolveTenantContext requires an active membership matching the route tenant slug

validation_and_runtime.cancel_validation: none required; cancellation discards local state only
validation_and_runtime.supporting_reply_validation: client trims and requires 1..20000 characters; server independently validates required|string|max:20000
validation_and_runtime.csrf: apiRequest supplies X-CSRF-TOKEN and same-origin credentials for the supporting POST
validation_and_runtime.secrets: no secret/provider/connector material is read or rendered by the control
validation_and_runtime.authoritative_reread: supporting Send closes the editor only after the comments query refetch callback resolves
validation_and_runtime.idempotency: Cancel is side-effect free and repeat-safe; supporting reply create is not automatically retried
validation_and_runtime.retry_and_cancellation: supporting reply mutation uses retry:false and disables Cancel while that mutation is pending
